html:
Andorrans approved their first written constitution in a referendum on 14 March 1993. It made Andorra a parliamentary democracy with the two co-princes as heads of state.

Before 1993 the co-princes held real power under the medieval paréage, and Andorra's place in the world was unclear. The constitution gave law-making to the General Council, set out rights and created courts. Political parties were allowed.

The same year Andorra joined the United Nations, and the Council of Europe the next. Its economy grew on tourism, skiing and duty-free shopping.
sum: Andorrans approved their first written constitution in a referendum on 14 March 1993. It made Andorra a parliamentary democracy with the two co-princes as heads of state.
